mapper.select: SELECT test_item ,test_method ,test_spec ,test_result ,order_dist ,item_cd ,test_type_method_id FROM tmp_test_type_method WHERE item_cd = #{itemCe} ORDER BY order_dist ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tmp_test_type_method ( item_cd, test_item, test_method, test_spec, test_result, order_dist, reg_id, upd_id ) VALUES ( #{itemCd}, #{testItem}, #{testMethod}, #{testSpec}, #{testResult}, #{orderDist}, #{userId}, #{userId} )
mapper.select: select a.test_no ,m.test_item ,m.test_method ,m.test_spec ,m.test_result ,a.test_date ,m.tester_name ,dbo.getCommonName('pass_state', a.pass_state) pass_state from tb_qc_test_type_method m inner join tb_qc_test_mst a on m.qc_test_id = a.qc_test_id inner join tb_pur_item b on b.test_no = a.test_no where a.test_date between #{strDate} and #{endDate} and a.test_state in ( 'ING','END') and b.item_cd = #{itemCd} order by m.order_dist, a.test_no
